Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

REDCapExploreR 0.1.0

  • Identify referenced checkbox options in Summary using REDCap field notation, raw codes, and labels. Add Referenced choice to relationship viewer tables and clarify the source choice-label column as Containing choice code. Demonstrate Fever-specific branching in the bundled codebook and vignette.

  • Rename the optional diagnostics viewer to Project Diagnostics and show only project-wide interpretation issues. Request include_inspection_log = TRUE separately for the complete inspection inventory and Full Inspection Log viewer.

  • Make relationship report coverage identical for every field using the same codebook. Project Coverage includes all project interpretation limits; field-specific evidence remains in Issues.

  • Handle REDCap’s explicit non-applicable event, form/event mapping, and arm responses for classic projects, and the response for projects without repeats. Codebooks, record-status data, and quality reports retain genuine API errors while supporting classic projects with or without repeating instruments.

  • Separate field-name matching from qualifier interpretation; known references remain linked when qualifiers need review. Support combined checkbox piping modifiers and flag cross-instrument embedding without hiding its reference.

  • Preserve metadata locations, expressions, action tags, and repeated-occurrence counts in relationship summaries. Label reference-chain steps without implying value propagation or event/instance continuity.

  • Include related interpretation issues and original evidence by default; keep Coverage project-wide and full diagnostics optional. Simplify viewer tables, use REDCap terminology, and demonstrate realistic weight/BMI relationships.

  • Expanded mock_codebook with upstream and downstream relationship examples, including indirect paths and interpretation notes. Viewer sections now use the same Field, Upstream, Downstream, Summary, and Coverage terms as the R report.

  • Add field_relationship_summary() with complete definitions, upstream and downstream connections, original reference evidence, neutral explanations, and explicit source coverage. No record exports or expression evaluation are required; rebuild older codebooks to include complete definitions.

  • Show all relationship references by default; readable relationship types and interpretation notes replace routine status codes in the viewer. R output retains the machine-readable type and resolution columns.

  • Summarize coverage by source and relevant interpretation notes, with bounded examples and aggregate limits elsewhere. Set include_diagnostics = TRUE to retain full project-wide diagnostics and expose the optional diagnostics tab.

  • Add searchable field-relationship viewers and standalone HTML saving. Scope viewer navigation to each root and support keyboard tab navigation.

  • Codebooks now retain complete standardized definitions and source availability, including canonical repeating-event keys.

  • Reject unsuccessful API responses instead of treating them as empty structure; retain recognized classic-project event responses and redact credentials from endpoint diagnostics.

  • Handle successful zero-column empty record exports and require the actual metadata-defined record identifier for nonempty data.

  • Preserve gray statuses as blank exports, resolve repeating instruments per event, and keep dashboard tiles distinct when display labels collide.

  • Evaluate numeric branching numerically, preserve quoted literals and exact categorical codes, and support explicit blank comparisons. Unsupported REDCap functions, smart variables, arithmetic, and event-qualified expressions remain assessable rather than suppressing required-field findings.

  • Restrict IQR calculations to structurally eligible finite observations and warn when unvalidated nonfinite values are excluded. Checkbox exclusivity follows metadata labels rather than legacy code suffixes.

  • Add report settings and missingness assessment coverage; clarify sparse-field denominators, completion percentages, and free-text review suggestions.

  • Consolidate instrument normalization, form structure, and completion extraction; separate retrieval, normalization, applicability, branching, and progress code.

  • Existing function signatures, finding identifiers, and summary column names are retained. Instrument metadata preserves original columns and adds standardized names; dashboard labels change only when needed to disambiguate tiles.

Developed by Richard Hanna.
